highlightsHeading: Everyone builds it. Everyone is in it.
heroHeading: Twenty-five students. One very large curriculum.
missionQuote: A Peachtown education promotes personal responsibility and self-reliance, as well as a sense of family, tolerance and community. Children learn at a pace that challenges, but does not intimidate or bore.
heroLede: An independent day school for Pre-K through grade 8, where classes are small enough that everyone builds the trebuchet, and everyone gets a part in the play.
highlightsLede: Classes are small enough that no one sits out. Every student takes a part in the play, a turn at the workbench, and a sample from the lake.
